items.title: Replace recursive-copy with own implementation
items.body:
Replace `recursive-copy` npm package by a simpler implementation with less options.

It's currently only used in `next export`. The new implementation will always follow symlinks and _expand_ it (meaning a symlink in the source tree pointing to a regular file will become a regular file in the destination tree). It will also always fail if a file in the destination folder already exists.

Todo :
- [x] update yarn.lock
- [x] do not fail if destination folder already exists

Fix https://github.com/zeit/next.js/issues/6941

items.title: with-cookie-auth: don't rely on the Host header
items.body:
Relying on the `Host` HTTP header [is a bad practice that can lead to severe security vulnerabilities](https://dzone.com/articles/what-is-a-host-header-attack).

Even the code contained in this example can cause some damages:

    curl -H 'Host: attacker.com'  http://localhost:3000/profile

It forces the server to make an HTTP request to `http://attacker.com/api/profile.js`. It may among other things:

* reveal the origin IP address of your server, that you may want to hide (for instance when using DDOS protection systems such as CloudFlare)
* give many details about your platform including the User Agent of the HTTP client you use, or even [the exact version of the OS your server uses](https://www.infoq.com/articles/tcp-syn-security-unauthorized-os/)
* allow an attacker to amplify a DDOS attack using your infrastructure

This PR fixes the issue by storing the API URL in the configuration instead of relying on untrusted headers.

items.title: Allow to describe initial props in the NextPage type
items.body:
_@types/next_ provided the `NextFunctionComponent` type to describe pages. It allowed us to specify the type of initial props separately from the type of all the props a page component might get. This is useful, because we can wrap a page component into some HOC that provides the page with additional props which don't belong to initial props.
So, I'd like to add initial props as the second generic type parameter to the `NextPage` type.

items.title: ncc Webpack build redux
items.body:
This reinstates the ncc webpack build (previously https://github.com/zeit/next.js/pull/7301, https://github.com/zeit/next.js/pull/6347), specifically fixing the issue in https://github.com/zeit/next.js/issues/7369.

Careful handling of remapping of externals is provided through the new `exports` object support in ncc, allowing better shared code.

See for example the webpack bundle technique in `bundled-webpack.js` and how that avoids duplication of webpack between usage. The autoDll override approach was also updated similarly to be fully ncc compatible.

Since fully automated multi-entry builds are not possible currently due to the various Webpack issues, these same techniques applied progressively to build all dependencies while retaining shared dependency links will be the best approach for next.js.

items.title: Fix styled-jsx not rendering when used in node_modules
items.body:
Removes transpiling `styled-jsx` for server build since it should not need to be transpiled and it causes problems since all modules need to use the same `styled-jsx` instance or else `flush` doesn't work correctly. 

So if we transpile it and it is included inside of the server build for a page but then require an external module from `node_modules` it will use a different instance of `styled-jsx` than the transpiled version.

Fixes: #7643
